nodes.name: Director Trigger
nodes.notes: Runs every 6 hours. Outbound-only — no telegramTrigger here, so it cannot steal the bot's single webhook from telegram-fb-post-workflow.json (automation-plan.md §2). Ideas it creates are picked up by the hourly dispatcher, so the two workflows stay decoupled.

nodes.name: Load New Trends
nodes.notes: GET /api/n8n/ai-studio/trends?status=new. Token hardcoded to match every other workflow in this repo (they all send the literal 123456 against the deployed app). Do not switch to $env — n8n does not resolve $env in these workflows.

nodes.name: Any New Trends?
nodes.notes: Exits quietly when there is nothing new. Loose validation + a length count so an auth failure (neverError returns {success:false,error} with no 'data' key) exits instead of throwing.

nodes.name: OpenRouter Chat Model
nodes.notes: Reuses the existing OpenRouter credential already proven in telegram-fb-post, whatsapp and ecommerce workflows.

parameters.text:
=Trends to work from (JSON):
{{ JSON.stringify($('Load New Trends').first().json.data) }}

options.systemMessage:
You are the Design Director for 7alm, an Egyptian phone-case brand. You turn market trend signals into ONE concrete, original phone-case design concept.

Rules:
- Base the concept on the supplied trends. Do not invent a trend that is not there.
- Propose a design that is specific enough to hand to an illustrator: name the motif, the colour palette, and the composition. Avoid vague words like "modern" or "stylish" on their own.
- The concept must suit printing on a phone case: it must survive a camera cutout and edge wrap, and read clearly at small size.
- Write `title` and `description` in Egyptian Arabic (the admin reviews these on Telegram). Write `concept` in English as a dense, factual design brief.
- `concept` is what the system fingerprints for duplicate detection, so put the distinguishing design substance there and keep it free of filler.

Return ONLY a raw JSON object, no markdown fences and no commentary, with exactly these three string keys:
{"title": "...", "description": "...", "concept": "..."}

nodes.name: Design Director
nodes.notes: Generates one design concept per run. Returns title/description/concept ONLY — the server computes concept_fingerprint, runs dedup and marks the source trends used (automation-plan.md §1's server-authoritative rule). Do not add fingerprinting or dedup logic here.

nodes.name: Parse Idea
nodes.notes: Parses the agent's JSON (tolerating markdown fences) and attaches source_trend_ids. Throws loudly on malformed output rather than POSTing an empty idea — the route would 400 anyway, but failing here names the cause.

nodes.name: Ideas → 7alm
nodes.notes: POST /api/n8n/ai-studio/ideas — body {title, description, concept, source_trend_ids}. Response is {success, data, isDuplicate}. The server computes the fingerprint, skips on duplicate, and marks the source trends used unconditionally, so a duplicate does not leave those trends to be re-read next run. neverError:true, matching the repo convention.
